content.text: No exclusivity obligation binds AP anywhere; § 1 expressly disclaims it. This meets the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale:
Section 1 (Kubient Services) expressly negates exclusivity and confirms AP may continue to offer or sell Inventory through other agents or third parties, so AP carries no sole-supplier or exclusive-dealing obligation. The only other "exclusive" references are unrelated (a non-exclusive licence to AP in § 2, exclusive jurisdiction in § 64, exclusive trademark ownership in § 65, and the exclusive-benefit/entire-agreement provisions in §§ 72-73), and the § 2 licence applies only if AP elects to use Kubient's ad serving technology. No right of first refusal, minimum-volume or requirements commitment appears anywhere. This sits at the preferred position, not merely the fallback, so no redline is proposed.</parationale>
